name: The Censor
source: The Censor is a dystopian visual novel. After years spent assimilating into the System, CJ489775 is visited by a ghost from her past and must decide whether to support the System or those who live Outside.
translation: 《审查者》是一部反乌托邦视觉小说。CJ489775多年融入“系统”后，一个来自过去的幽灵来访，她必须决定支持系统，还是支持生活在“外界”的人。
